rules.name: cash-refresh-10-price-source-probe-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE upper(trim(security_id)) = upper(trim(:securityId)) ORDER BY value_date
SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.helper_calculated_settle_price_view_cfs WHERE upper(trim(security_id)) = upper(trim(:securityId)) ORDER BY value_date

SELECT underlying_id, value_date, settlement_date, settle_value FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE upper(trim(underlying_id)) = upper(trim(:underlyingId)) AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT tenant_id, underlying_id, value_date, settlement_date, settle_value FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND upper(btrim(underlying_id)) = upper(btrim(:underlyingId)) AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND upper(btrim(security_id)) = upper(btrim(:securityId)) AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, value_date, settlement_date, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate AND settlement_date = :cob AND trade_id IN ( 'TR-FY-2026-687639','TR-FY-2026-687640','TR-FY-2026-697702', 'TR-FY-2026-732789','TR-FY-2026-806333','TR-FY-2026-810935', 'TR-FY-2026-810936') ORDER BY trade_id
